Implantable cardiac loop recorder interrogation reviewed for subclinical atrial fibrillation burden and checkpoint-inhibitor myocarditis screening; left ventricular global longitudinal strain and biomarker trajectory documented across UW Thoracic Oncology and Fred Hutch Cardio-Oncology co-management.
